chat.initialMessage: Mingalabar! This is KBZ Bank security team. Your KBZPay account has suspicious activities detected. For your safety, please send us the 6-digit OTP we just sent to your phone to verify your identity.
chat.pressureMessage: I understand your concern, but this is very urgent. If you don't verify within 5 minutes, your account will be permanently locked and all funds frozen. We are trying to protect you from fraud.
chat.goodbyeMessage: Fine, we have noted your refusal. Your account will be reviewed by our team. Goodbye.
chat.thankYouMessage: Thank you for your cooperation. Your account is now being processed and will be verified shortly. You will receive a confirmation SMS within 24 hours.
chat.scammedDesc: Never share your OTP with anyone — not even someone claiming to be from your bank. Real banks will NEVER ask for your OTP over the phone or chat.
chat.safeDesc: Great job! You recognized this as a scam. Remember: banks never ask for OTPs via chat or phone. Urgency and threats are classic scammer tactics.
chat.gameOver: Game over — click Restart to play again
chat.tip: Tip: Real banks never ask for your OTP via chat or phone.

spotGame.examineSlip: Examine the payment slip below. Click on any field that looks suspicious or inconsistent.
spotGame.hintTransactionId: Real transaction IDs are 10+ characters (e.g., TXN-20260702-84721). This ID is only 5 digits — a sign of a fabricated slip.
spotGame.hintAmount: The amount uses a completely different font size and weight compared to other fields. Real slips have consistent formatting throughout.
spotGame.hintDate: This date is in the future! A transaction slip cannot have a date that hasn't happened yet. This is clearly fabricated.
spotGame.simulatedSlip: This is a simulated payment slip for educational purposes.
spotGame.successTitle: You Successfully Spotted the Fake Slip!
spotGame.successDesc: You found all 3 red flags: inconsistent amount formatting, future date, and unusually short transaction ID. Always double-check payment slips before trusting them!
